learning_groups.title: Work with components / Capture a design
learning_groups.explanation: Learn transistors as switches, logic gates and truth tables, digital timing basics, then apply the ideas in a small task. Learn schematic symbols and nets, component values and tolerances, design rules and erc, then apply the ideas in a small task.

learning_groups.title: Plan a simple PCB / Deliver a simulated hardware design
learning_groups.explanation: Learn footprints and packages, pcb placement and routing, ground and power practices, then apply the ideas in a small task. Learn define low-voltage circuit, simulate and review behavior, create schematic and pcb layout, then apply the ideas in a small task.

purpose: Understand how devices connect and exchange information. Build, inspect and troubleshoot small networks using simulations and permitted test setups.

A documented check of addressing, routing and name resolution

purpose: Assess the security of systems with explicit permission. Learn a systematic testing workflow using only training labs and authorised targets.
